note: The verification matrix: the 11 modes single-stage at 704x480 (5 s, or the length of the supplied clip or audio), Upscale x2 on modes 05 and 11, the decoder A/B on mode 01, the duration head at 512x960, a Hub LoRA at 0.8, the prompt enhancer, and the operator's own audio. Paths are relative to --assets-dir (the lead's assets folder); inputs are independent files, never this harness's own outputs. Every audio call takes its length from its audio or sets one its audio covers. It does not fit one UTC day at worst case: run it with --out DIR and continue on the next day with --resume.
